verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships AI features, including AI Decisioning, agents, the MCP server and Ad Studio, so asking whether customer data is used to train AI models is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no documented AI-training opt-out, no no-training commitment and no data-usage policy for AI. Warehouse-native claims ('never copies your data') and SOC2 mentions are about a different privacy subject, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
